## About
Cal's love for cars started when he was a young boy in Lebanon. He made sure he knew all makes and models, both technically and mechanically, then brought those skills to the Los Angeles area, starting out in West LA.
He later came to the South Bay, where he was lead mechanic for Jim and Jacks before opening C's Auto. Today the shop serves South Bay residents and workers from Inglewood Avenue in Lawndale.
His approach is simple: client trust and top notch service. We handle dealer maintenance and repair, from routine service to engine rebuilds, and customers have given us a 4.8 rating on Google from 79 reviews.

## Services
- Computer diagnostics: When something feels off, we'll run computer diagnostics to track down the cause.
- Brake service: Brake inspection and repair to keep your car stopping the way it should.
- Routine maintenance: Scheduled mileage maintenance to keep your car running right between bigger repairs.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We service both domestic and foreign models, new and late models.

Q: What should I bring for routine maintenance?
A: Please bring your car's maintenance schedule so we can make sure the routine service is accurate.
